offeredEvidence.quote: How can I expedite my filing? We do not offer expedited services. We do offer walk-in services and some online filings.

notes: Florida is the first researched 'no' in this namespace, and it is a real finding rather than a gap: the Division of Corporations answers the question directly on its own FAQ  -  it does not offer expedited services, and offers walk-in service instead, most of which it completes while the filer waits. Recording this as null would have implied the question was never asked. Nothing here says how long a routine filing takes; that is a separate question this record does not answer.
needsReview: Standard processing time not researched; the Division publishes no figure on the page cited here.

sources.citation: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
sources.title: Division FAQs  -  question 17, expedited service is not offered
